Container.Name: omniarr
Container.Overview: Movies + TV in one app. TMDB / TheTVDB metadata, TRaSH Guides quality profiles, custom formats and naming, Newznab indexers and NZBGet. Separate 1080p and 4K root folders.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Share holding both usenet downloads and media (TRaSH layout) so imports are instant

Config.Name: Web UI username
Config.Description: Name of the admin account created from the password below (first start only)

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional: creates the admin account on first start. Leave empty to create it in the web UI instead

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI

Config.Name: TheTVDB API key
Config.Description: Optional - can also be set in the web UI
